lines.en: Glossolalia (ɡläsəˈlālēə): noun
lines.zh: Glossolalia（ɡläsəˈlālēə）：名词

lines.en: Definition: The phenomenon of (apparently) speaking in an unknown language, especially in religious worship.
lines.zh: 释义：（表面上）说着一种未知语言的现象，尤指宗教崇拜中的情形。

lines.en: Many have described it as the unmistakable feeling of the lord taking over one’s body and speaking through it in tongues indiscernible to even the most accomplished of polyglots.
lines.zh: 许多人把它描述成一种确凿无疑的感觉：主接管了一个人的身体，借它说话，用的是连最精通多种语言的人都无法辨认的音节。

lines.en: To me, it means nothing.
lines.zh: 对我来说，它什么都不是。

lines.en: It is simply an excuse for one to feel a connection to something that does not exist.
lines.zh: 它不过是一个借口，让人觉得自己与某个并不存在的东西产生了联系。

lines.en: And so I will wait beneath this girl, ready to catch her when she falls.
lines.zh: 于是我就在这个女孩下面等着，准备好在她坠落时接住她。

lines.en: For even the highest of powers must descend eventually.
lines.zh: 因为即便是最高的权柄，也终有降临的一日。

lines.en: And they are not afraid to use those below them to cushion the blow.
lines.zh: 而它们并不惮于利用比自己低贱的存在来充当缓冲。
